method: Condition is a real IDOT reading where one exists (692 segments) and an openly synthetic placeholder otherwise (2,603 segments). The deterioration curve shape is a logistic decay fitted to Boone's own measurements where the data supports a fit, and a documented default elsewhere. Forward projection is modelled in both cases.
caveat: A single survey cycle cannot establish deterioration rates: SURF_YR records the last surface treatment, so treatment history is confounded with age, and only one of six functional classes shows a usable age-condition relationship in Boone. Synthetic condition values are placeholders for a survey that has not happened -- they are not estimates of these specific roads and must be replaced wholesale with survey results.

Interstate.not_fitted_because: insufficient age variation in measured samples

Major Collector.not_fitted_because: no age-condition relationship in Boone data (r=-0.00)
